# Beck Institute

> Beck Institute is a leading provider of evidence-based Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT) training, certification, and mental health services worldwide.

Founded on the principles of Dr. Aaron T. Beck and Dr. Judith Beck, the Beck Institute offers comprehensive CBT education through live workshops, on-demand courses, professional supervision, and multiple certification pathways for clinicians. The institute also operates Beck Institute Cares, a therapy clinic providing direct CBT treatment services, and the Center for CT-R (Recovery-Oriented Cognitive Therapy) for serious mental health conditions.

## Certification Programs

- [CBT Certification Overview](https://beckinstitute.org/certification): Beck Institute CBT Certification programs for clinicians and mental health professionals
- [CBT Certified Clinician (BICBT-CC)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-clinician): Beck Institute CBT Certified Clinician (BICBT-CC) certification program details and eligibility
- [CBT Certified Master Clinician (BICBT-CMC)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-master-clinician): Beck Institute CBT Certified Master Clinician (BICBT-CMC) certification requirements
- [CBT Certified Supervisor (BICBT-CS)](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certified-supervisor): Beck Institute CBT Certified Supervisor (BICBT-CS) certification program details
- [CBT Certification for Youth Clinicians](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/cbt-certification-for-clinicians-working-with-youth): CBT Certified Clinician: Youth (BICBT-CCY) specialization for adolescent clinicians
- [Work Sample Submission](https://beckinstitute.org/certification/work-sample): Work Sample submission requirements for Beck Institute CBT Certification credentialing

## Training & Education

- [CBT Training Overview](https://beckinstitute.org/training): Beck Institute CBT training overview: workshops, courses, organizational training programs
- [Professional CBT Training](https://beckinstitute.org/training-for-professionals): Professional CBT training enhancing clinician skills and evidence-based techniques
- [Organizational CBT Training](https://beckinstitute.org/training-for-organizations): Organizational CBT and CT-R training program for diverse workplace teams
- [On-Demand Online Courses](https://beckinstitute.org/training/training-catalog/about-on-demand-online-training): Self-paced on-demand CBT and CT-R courses for global mental health professionals
- [Live Virtual Workshops](https://beckinstitute.org/beck-institute-live-virtual-workshops): Live Zoom workshops on CBT topics: anxiety, trauma, addiction, weight loss treatment
- [On-Demand Webinars](https://beckinstitute.org/training/training-catalog/beck-institute-on-demand-webinars): On-demand lecture-based webinars covering CBT, ASD, ADHD, and mental health topics

## Supervision & Consultation

- [Supervision Services](https://beckinstitute.org/training/supervision): Individual and group CBT supervision for mental health professionals and certification
- [Consultation Services](https://beckinstitute.org/training/consultation): CBT consultation services for clinicians using Cognitive Therapy Rating Scale guidance

- [Center for CT-R](https://beckinstitute.org/center-for-ct-r): Center for Recovery-Oriented Cognitive Therapy (CT-R) promoting serious mental health treatment
